name: inspection-report
title: Inspection review report
for_each: select id,code from inspections order by code

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select code,title,severity,owner,due_on,state from findings where inspection_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.sql: select revision,reference,sha256,actor from evidence where inspection_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: References point to separately held files. A stored hash does not certify the contents.

name: action-register
title: Project corrective action register
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Actions and verification
sections.sql: select f.code,i.asset,f.title,f.owner,f.due_on,f.state,f.resolution,f.verification from findings f join inspections i on i.id=f.inspection_id where i.project_id=$1 order by f.due_on,f.code

name: evidence-handover
title: Inspection evidence handover
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Inspection review status
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,reviewed_revision,reviewer from inspections where project_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Evidence manifest
sections.sql: select i.code,e.revision,e.reference,e.sha256 from evidence e join inspections i on i.id=e.inspection_id where i.project_id=$1 order by i.code,e.revision
